title: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.21541v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce SciResearch-Eval, an interactive benchmark of scientific judgment built on a standard laboratory problem: measuring a material's thermal properties by heating it and fitting a heat-conduction simulator. An agent designs its own experiments, uses a supplied simulator that may be under-resolved or physically wrong, and reports each property with a 95% interval. To our knowledge it is the first benchmark to combine agent-designed experiments, a deliberately flawed simulator, and proper scoring of calibrated intervals against exact ground truth. On a held-out split (93 tasks, 9 models, 2,511 episodes), models handle procedural traps. When the simulator is missing physics, most report wrong values while stating they are 95% sure: their ranges contain the truth in 20-62% of cases, against 94% for GPT-6 Astra and 99% for Claude Fable 5.2. translated_title: SciResearch-Eval：评估自主实验智能体的科学判断力
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SciResearch-Eval，这是一个建立在标准实验室问题之上的科学判断力交互式基准测试：通过加热材料并拟合热传导模拟器来测量材料的热学性质。智能体需要自行设计实验，使用一个可能分辨率不足或物理上存在错误的模拟器，并以95%的置信区间报告每个性质的数值。据我们所知，这是首个将智能体自主设计的实验、故意带有缺陷的模拟器，以及针对精确真值的校准区间严格评分相结合的基准测试。在一个留出测试集上（93个任务、9个模型、2,511次实验回合），模型们能够应对程序性的陷阱。然而当模拟器缺失某些物理机制时，大多数模型会报告错误的数值，同时声称自己有95%的把握：它们的区间仅在20-62%的情况下包含真实值，而GPT-6 Astra为94%，Claude Fable 5.2为99%。在默认努力程度下，表现不佳的Claude 5.5模型很少能诊断出模拟器缺失的物理机制（Opus仅为3……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个结合智能体自主设计实验、故意有缺陷的模拟器以及校准区间严格评分的科学判断力交互式基准SciResearch-Eval，并发现当模拟器物理机制缺失时，多数模型会在声称95%置信的情况下报告错误结果。
en_tdlr: SciResearch-Eval is the first interactive benchmark combining agent-designed experiments, a deliberately flawed simulator, and rigorous scoring of calibrated intervals, revealing that most models report wrong values with claimed 95% confidence when the simulator lacks physics.
